personalInfo.name: Gnanasekaran Janushikha
personalInfo.title: Full-Stack Developer | Cloud & AI Enthusiast
personalInfo.bio: Third-year Computer Science and Engineering undergraduate at the University of Moratuwa with a strong interest in software engineering, full-stack development, and AI. A quick learner who enjoys solving real-world problems, taking on new challenges, and working in collaborative environments. Seeking an internship opportunity to apply my skills, contribute to impactful software projects, and grow as an engineer.

projects.title: Code Pulse
projects.description: An ongoing SaaS platform for automated code review and technical debt tracking, integrating GitHub webhooks, reviewdog, and RabbitMQ to analyze pull requests, store review findings in MongoDB, and assess technical debt using the SQALE method. Includes a business-oriented dashboard that translates code-quality metrics into simplified project health indicators for non-technical stakeholders, with Keycloak-based authentication, role-based access control, and Docker containerization.

projects.title: Console RPG Arena
projects.description: An ongoing Java console RPG demonstrating OOP fundamentals (inheritance, polymorphism, interfaces) and design patterns (Factory, Strategy, Observer, Singleton) through a custom character and combat system, with ANSI escape sequences for CLI formatting.

projects.title: Medi-center
projects.description: A full-stack healthcare marketplace with role-based access (Public/Registrar/Admin), JWT authentication, and admin-approved provider onboarding. Features location-based doctor/pharmacy search with Leaflet maps, specialty filters, and a review/rating system, plus a prescription-to-delivery ordering flow with file upload, pharmacist pricing, Stripe Checkout, and order status tracking. Also includes a rule-based medicine info assistant structured for future Claude API integration.

projects.title: AgriSenseNet – Smart Agriculture Platform
projects.description: A group project building a precision agriculture platform using IoT sensors, real-time data pipelines, and ML models to automate irrigation decisions and crop monitoring for mixed-vegetable farming. Sensor data (soil moisture, temperature, humidity, pressure, solar radiation) is collected via ESP32 devices, streamed through Apache Kafka, processed with ML models, and displayed on a web/mobile dashboard. My contribution: modular Terraform scripts automating the AWS infrastructure, including a secure VPC with public/private subnets, private EC2 instances for the Kubernetes control plane and workers, a Bastion Host for secure SSH access, and a Network Load Balancer for external service requests.

projects.title: ResQLink
projects.description: A group project building a centralized real-time platform for disaster, missing-person, animal-rescue, and camp-request reporting, with admin-verified camp registrations and AI-driven incident prioritization and resource recommendations. Enables multilingual SMS reporting with offline support for reliable incident submission in low-connectivity situations, and automates call transcription and incident report generation to reduce manual reporting overhead. My contribution: an AI-powered call recording transcription feature and the automated field-intake pipeline.
